title: Among Us
description: Finish tasks on the ship while keeping an eye on the rest of the crew.
notes: A Unity web build with about 865 MB of game files listed by the loader. Close other tabs before the first launch.

title: Beatblock
description: Swing a paddle around Cranky and catch the blocks on the beat.
notes: Move the paddle around the circle in time with the music. Mouse or trackpad recommended.

title: Bendy and the Ink Machine
description: Return to an abandoned cartoon studio and follow the trail left by its ink machine.
notes: Explore a deserted animation studio in this ink-stained horror adventure.

title: Buckshot Roulette
description: Take a seat across from the Dealer in a grim tabletop game of chance.
notes: A tabletop horror game set in the back room of a nightclub.

title: Call of Duty: Black Ops Zombies
description: Hold the barricades and survive another round on classic Black Ops Zombies maps.
notes: Desktop keyboard and mouse required. The port needs a 64-bit browser, WebGL 2, and a 1.5 GiB game heap plus graphics and audio memory.

title: DELTATRAVELER
description: Guide Kris, Susie, and Noelle through worlds beyond their own in this turn-based fan RPG.
notes: Kris and Susie cross unfamiliar worlds in this turn-based fan adventure.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
description: Join the school literature club and share poems in a visual novel that turns into psychological horror.
notes: A psychological horror visual novel. The porter recommends Chrome and reports a possible progression limit in Act 3.

title: DOOM (Shareware)
description: Storm the Phobos base in the original shareware episode. WebPrBoom also includes two Freedoom campaigns.
notes: WebPrBoom includes the original shareware episode and both Freedoom campaigns. Use a keyboard and mouse or a gamepad.

title: Duke Nukem 3D
description: Fight through alien-occupied Los Angeles in a classic first-person shooter.
notes: The game host opens in its own tab. Select “Click here to load” for its roughly 19 MB classic shooter build.

title: Fallout
description: Leave Vault 13 and cross the wasteland in search of a replacement water chip.
notes: The Community Edition engine requires a copy of Fallout. Open the port in its own tab.

title: Fallout 2
description: Lead the Chosen One across post-nuclear California in search of a way to save Arroyo.
notes: Choose your Fallout 2 installation folder in the player. Game files stay in your browser.

title: Fears to Fathom: Home Alone
description: An ordinary evening home alone takes a turn in the first episode of Fears to Fathom.
notes: Episode one of the horror anthology. A teenager is home alone for the evening.

title: Feed and Grow: Fish
description: Start as a small fish and work your way up the underwater food chain.
notes: Swim, hunt, and grow. The Unity browser port is a work in progress.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's
description: Keep watch over Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza. Cameras and doors share the same dwindling power supply.
notes: The port downloads a split game archive when you launch it. The first load can take a moment.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
description: Check the vents, wind the music box, and keep your Freddy mask close.
notes: The port downloads a split game archive when you launch it. The first load can take a moment.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
description: Follow Springtrap through the security cameras of Fazbear’s Fright.
notes: The port downloads a split game archive when you launch it. The first load can take a moment.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
description: Listen at the bedroom doors and check the closet before the lights go out.
notes: The port downloads a split game archive when you launch it. The first load can take a moment.

title: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
description: Build a pizzeria by day and keep a close ear on the vents after closing.
notes: The port downloads a split game archive when you launch it. The first load can take a moment.

title: Gang Beasts
description: Grapple, stumble, and throw your way through the hazards of Beef City.
notes: A physics brawler with a large first download. The port targets desktop WebGL.

title: Geometry Dash
description: Jump to the beat through spikes, portals, and obstacles.
notes: An unofficial WebAssembly port. Very complex custom levels can run more slowly than the main levels.

title: Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy
description: Swing a sledgehammer from inside a cauldron and find a way up a very unforgiving mountain.
notes: Climb with a sledgehammer. A mouse or trackpad gives you precise control.

title: Gorilla Tag
description: Use your arms to move between trees in this browser adaptation of Gorilla Tag.
notes: Move through the forest in Boolonx’s browser adaptation.

title: Granny
description: Unlock the way out of Granny’s house. Every dropped object gives away your position.
notes: Find a way out of Granny’s house and keep the noise down.

title: Granny 3
description: Explore a new house and its grounds while staying out of sight of its residents.
notes: Explore a larger house guarded by Granny and Grandpa.

title: Granny: Chapter Two
description: Search for an escape route while Granny and Grandpa patrol the house.
notes: Escape the house while Granny and Grandpa are on patrol.

title: Happy Wheels
description: Pilot a cast of unlikely riders through ragdoll obstacle courses.
notes: Ride through obstacle courses on the original developer’s browser player.

title: Minecraft: Story Mode
description: Lead Jesse and friends through a block-built adventure where your choices shape the story.
notes: Try the in-game Low (720p) or Minimum (540p) preset on a Chromebook. Opening the game site can enable multithreading on supported devices.

title: People Playground
description: Build strange contraptions and experiment with the interactions between their parts.
notes: Build, connect, and experiment with objects in a physics sandbox.

title: R.E.P.O.
description: Carry fragile valuables to safety while creatures stalk the rooms around you.
notes: Retrieve fragile valuables in this physics-based horror game. Browser features can differ from the desktop release.

title: Raft
description: Haul flotsam aboard, craft supplies, and turn a tiny raft into a home.
notes: Catch debris and expand your raft as it drifts across the sea.

title: Skate 3 (Fan Game)
description: Take a fan-built skate engine onto the streets with your own converted copy of Skate 3.
notes: Bring your own converted copy of Skate 3 and a WebGPU-capable browser. The fan engine hosts no game data.

title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run
description: Drive through Springfield, pick up missions, and explore on foot in this browser reconstruction.
notes: A browser reconstruction with touch driving controls. Turn off High Quality in the game if needed.

title: UNDERTALE
description: Find a path through the Underground in a fan-made browser interpretation of UNDERTALE.
notes: This alternate fan port supports keyboard and touch. The originally requested game folder is offline.

title: Who's Your Daddy?!
description: A curious baby and a very busy parent turn an ordinary house into a physics playground.
notes: The original browser port opens a Unity playfield. Keyboard and mouse recommended.

title: Yandere Simulator
description: Learn the school’s routines and plan your moves in this stealth simulation.
notes: A stealth simulation with a large WebGL build. Desktop controls are recommended.
